rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Item dated 1 March 2004, 17:17: in consultations with the leaders of the State Duma's parliamentary majority the President proposed Mikhail Fradkov as candidate for Chairman of the Government; later, at a meeting with Government members, he described Михаил Ефимович Фрадков, Russia's representative to the Commission of the European Communities, as a good administrator and hoped the Duma would support the candidacy.
